scenarios.name: Keep the window Close action available to the desktop

scenario_steps.name: a writable copy of `fixtures/cad/extrusion/extrusion-rect-8mm.opd` is open in the MCAD Software
the user creates a sketch on the XY datum plane without saving the part
the MCAD Software has an open part document with unsaved changes
the user invokes the desktop window Close shortcut
a save-changes prompt identifies the part document
the main window remains open and the part retains its unsaved changes
